title: SmartPick
description: A smart inventory assistant that instantly removes blacklisted items from the world instead of picking them up. Clean & fast! ✨
body:
# 💎 SmartPick - The Ultimate Anti-Clutter Solution

Tired of your inventory being filled with unwanted Cobblestone, Seeds, or Rotten Flesh? **SmartPick** allows players to create a personal blacklist of items. When a blacklisted item is approached, it is instantly removed from the world instead of filling up your inventory!


### ✨ Features
* 🚀 **Instant Item Removal:** Unlike other plugins that just cancel the pickup (leaving the item on the floor), SmartPick removes it instantly to prevent "Inventory Full" fake alerts.
* ⌨️ **Smart Tab-Completion:** Fully supports auto-completion for all Minecraft materials. No more typing long item names!
* 🎨 **Hex Color Support:** Beautifully formatted messages with support for modern HEX colors (`&#FFFFFF`).
* 💾 **Persistent Data:** Your personal blacklist is saved even after the server restarts.
* 🌍 **Multi-Item Support:** Add or remove multiple items at once using commas (e.g., `/sp add dirt,stone`).
* 🔓 **Public Access:** Designed for players! Anyone can manage their own list without needing OP (Operators only need permission for reloads).


### 🛠 Commands
`/sp add <item>` - Adds item(s) to your blacklist |
`/sp remove <item>` - Removes item(s) from your blacklist |
`/sp list` - Shows your current blacklisted items |
`/sp reload` - Reloads the configuration file |


### ⚙️ Supported Versions
* **Minecraft Versions:** 1.20.x, 1.21.x (and newer)
* **Java Version:** Java 21+
* **API:** Spigot, Paper, Pufferfish, Purpur


### 👨‍💻 Developer
Developed with ❤️ by **Lynnnx** (BlockForge Studio).


### 📸 Installation
1. Download **SmartPick_v1.0.1.jar**.
2. Drop it into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. Enjoy a clean inventory!
